+"""Directed behavioural alignment with repulsion for selected codewords."""

+import torch

+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Return the masked directed codebook-rotation objective.
+
+    Nearest-neighbour selection is discrete (indices are detached), while the
+    selected codeword vectors remain connected to autograd.
+    """
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    cos_target = parameters.get("cos_target", 0.8)
+    repulsion = parameters.get("repulsion", 0.1)
+    separation_scale = parameters.get("separation_scale", 0.25)
+    weight = parameters.get("weight", 1e-4)
+
+    # Index selection only; gradients flow through the chosen codewords below.
+    i = (source.detach()[:, None, :] - codebook.detach()[None, :, :]).square().sum(-1).argmin(-1)
+    j = (target.detach()[:, None, :] - codebook.detach()[None, :, :]).square().sum(-1).argmin(-1)
+    ci, cj = codebook[i], codebook[j]
+    u = (target - source) / ((target - source).norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    delta = cj - ci
+    v = delta / (delta.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    alignment = (u * v).sum(-1)
+    separation_sq = (cj - ci).square().sum(-1)
+    per_pair = (alignment - cos_target).square() + repulsion * torch.exp(
+        -separation_sq / (separation_scale ** 2)
+    )
+    masked = per_pair * mask.to(dtype=per_pair.dtype, device=per_pair.device)
+    return weight * masked.mean()
